alt: Gregory Lake and the hills of Nuwara Eliya
transport: Private air conditioned car with an English speaking chauffeur guide throughout

expert.name: Aditya
expert.role: Sri Lanka expert at Hi Tours
expert.quote: Kandy, the hills and then the coast. Sri Lanka works best when you let the island cool you down before it warms you up again.
expert.tip: Carry a light sweater for Nuwara Eliya. It sits at nearly 1,900 metres and evenings are surprisingly chilly even in April.

summary: Five value packed days built around the hills: two nights in the tea country at Nuwara Eliya, a night in Kandy with the Tooth Relic temple, and a last night in Colombo.
included: Included: 4 nights in standard and deluxe class hotels with breakfast and lunch or dinner daily; private airport transfers and all road travel in an air conditioned car with chauffeur guide; a private full day Nuwara Eliya sightseeing tour; a private half day Kandy sightseeing tour; a private full day Colombo sightseeing tour. Entrance tickets are payable locally.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Sri Lanka ETA visa fees; lunches unless stated; entrance tickets where marked as payable locally; travel insurance; optional excursions; tips and personal expenses.
